name: Rose Fryberg
source:
An earnest girl born in Volcano Kingdom. Yearning to be like the legendary hero Lebsa, she knocks on the door of the prestigious St. Elmore Knight Academy in Volcano Kingdom. Her only family is her kindly father and a strange pet bird called Lily. With the help of her father, she makes her way through the world, working toward a knighthood while dealing with her unusual classmates. 

[Taken from [url=https://volcano-princess.com/en/index.html]English Official site[/url]]

Her name, birthdate, and blood type are all customizable.
